Hey everyone, welcome back. Today I'm going to show you how to automatically post new YouTube uploads to your Discord server using n8n.

First, open n8n and create a new workflow. Add a trigger node — search for "YouTube" and pick the "On new video" trigger. You'll need to connect your YouTube account here, so click "Create new credential" and go through the Google OAuth login.

Once that's connected, set the channel ID you want to watch. I'm using my own channel for this example, you'd swap in yours.

Next, add an action node — search for Discord and choose "Send Message." Same deal, you'll need to authenticate with a Discord webhook or bot token, whichever you've already got set up.

For the message, just map the video title and URL from the trigger node into the text field. I usually format mine as "New video is up: {{title}} - {{url}}" but honestly format it however you like, that part's up to you.

Then hit save, toggle the workflow to active, and you're done. Every time you publish a new video it'll ping your Discord automatically.

One more thing — if you want it to only post for certain video categories, there's a filter node you can add before the Discord step, but I won't go into that today.
